recognize_zh: 組合圖：A 骨髓抹片中為大量母細胞（實線箭頭），另有一團深染、互相黏附的細胞群（虛線箭頭）；B 骨髓切片細胞密度高，可見與造血組織不同的病灶區；C 核染色免疫染色把成群的腫瘤細胞染成棕色，顯示癌轉移與白血病並存。
features: Panel A: aspirate smear with sheets of monotonous blasts (solid arrow)
Panel A: dense, dark-staining cohesive cell cluster (dashed arrow) distinct from blasts, consistent with a metastatic tumor clump
Panel B: hypercellular marrow biopsy with a blast-rich infiltrate and a focal area of different texture (dashed arrow)
Panel C: nuclear immunostain (antibody not labeled) highlighting cohesive nests of tumor cells amid negative leukemic marrow
describe_en: This composite figure shows a bone marrow aspirate (A) composed predominantly of monotonous blasts (solid arrow), with a separate dense, cohesive clump of dark-staining cells (dashed arrow). The core biopsy (B) is hypercellular and largely replaced by a blast-rich infiltrate, with a focal area of different morphology (dashed arrow). An immunostain with nuclear positivity (C; antibody not specified) highlights cohesive nests of tumor cells within otherwise negative marrow. Findings are consistent with concurrent acute myeloid leukemia and metastatic breast carcinoma; the specific markers (e.g., GATA3 or ER for carcinoma, CD34/MPO for blasts) should be confirmed.

ddx.dx: Megakaryocyte clusters or aspirate particle artifact
ddx.vs: Megakaryocytes are single large cells with granular cytoplasm and are CD61-positive, whereas carcinoma clusters are cohesive nests positive for keratin, GATA3, or ER.

ddx.dx: Therapy-related myeloid neoplasm after breast cancer treatment
ddx.vs: This is a clinical distinction based on prior chemotherapy or radiation and cytogenetics such as KMT2A rearrangement or complex karyotype, not morphology.

ddx.dx: Metastatic carcinoma alone with reactive changes
ddx.vs: Absence of CD34/MPO-positive blast sheets and a normal blast count would exclude concurrent leukemia.
